description: Search the CERN Open Data Portal's datasets, software, environments, documentation and supplementary records with exact-vocabulary filters and an optional full-text query. The filters are experiment, record type, physics category, keyword, collision energy and type, file format, data-taking year, event count, availability, collection, and LHCb magnet polarity, stripping stream and stripping version. Returns compact hits with recids plus live facet counts. Each facet ignores its own filter, so its counts show the alternatives under the other filters. Filter values are exact upstream; common spellings are normalized, and cern_opendata_list_reference lists the vocabulary. Paging reaches the first 10,000 matches.

availability.description: Up to 4 availability states (OR): online, partial, ondemand (tape; request before download), requested.

category.description: Up to 20 simulated-dataset categories (OR): primary (Exotica, Higgs Physics, Standard Model Physics, Supersymmetry) or Primary::Secondary (Higgs Physics::Standard Model). Case/separator normalized. Commas stay within an item (Exotica::Heavy Fermions, Heavy Righ-Handed Neutrinos). Heavy-Ion Physics also matches its leading-space spelling. cern_opendata_list_reference topic categories lists all values.

collection.description: Up to 10 exact, case-sensitive collections (OR), e.g. CMS-Validated-Runs; copy a record's collections spellings.

items.description: One collection name, exact and case-sensitive.

collision_energy.description: Up to 15 energies (OR), e.g. 7TeV, 8TeV, 13TeV, 5.02TeV. "13TeV, 13.6TeV" is one value/item.

collision_type.description: Up to 6 collision types (OR): pp, PbPb, pPb, e+e-, Interfill. PbPb also matches Pb-Pb.

experiment.description: Up to 9 experiments (OR): ALICE, ATLAS, CMS, DELPHI, JADE, LHCb, OPERA, PHENIX, TOTEM. Case normalized.

file_type.description: Up to 20 formats/data tiers (OR): nanoaod, miniaod, aod, root, DAOD_PHYSLITE, csv, etc. Known-value case normalized.

keywords.description: Up to 10 verbatim, case-sensitive keywords (OR); Education differs from education. A comma within a keyword stays in one item.

limit.description: Hits per page, 1-50. A value above 50 is served at 50.

magnet_polarity.description: Up to 2 LHCb collision-dataset polarities (OR): MagDown, MagUp. Case normalized.

page.description: Page number, from 1, counting pages of the limit applied. page × limit may not exceed 10,000.

query.description: Verbatim OpenSearch query_string: AND between terms, double weight for title matches. Supports title:"…", recid:(1 OR 2), run_period:("Run2012B"); cern_opendata_list_reference topic query_syntax lists forms. Omit for filters alone.

sort.description: bestmatch (relevance), mostrecent (by date_published, newest first), title (A-Z) or title_desc (Z-A). Omitted: bestmatch with a query, mostrecent (newest first) without.

stripping_stream.description: Up to 11 LHCb stripping streams (OR), e.g. BHADRON, CHARM, DIMUON, EW, LEPTONIC; also matches stripping docs. Case normalized. cern_opendata_list_reference topic lhcb lists them.

stripping_version.description: Up to 12 LHCb stripping versions (OR), e.g. stripping21, stripping21r1p2. Case normalized.

type.description: Up to 7 types (OR): Dataset, Documentation, Environment, Software, Supplementaries, News, or Primary::Secondary (Dataset::Collision, Dataset::Simulated). Omit for all six primaries; Glossary is excluded.

year_from.description: Inclusive earliest data-taking year; alone means onward. For one year, set both year bounds to it.

year_to.description: Inclusive latest data-taking year; alone means through this year.

applied_filters.description: The filters as the server applied them.

expanded.description: Values sent as several upstream spellings.

number_events.description: Event-count range sent: min--max, min-- or --max (inclusive).

sort_defaulted.description: True when sort was omitted, so the server chose it: bestmatch with a query, mostrecent (newest first) without.

type.description: Types sent (OR); the six served primaries when type_defaulted.

type_defaulted.description: True when type was omitted and the six served primaries were sent.

unrecognized_values.description: Values not in the verified vocabulary, sent as given; cern_opendata_list_reference lists the accepted spellings.

year.description: Data-taking year range sent: from--to, from-- or --to (inclusive).

cap.description: The page size (limit) applied to this call.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_query`: query leaves a parenthesis, range bracket or double quote unbalanced, or ends in an escaping backslash (refused before any request); or the portal rejected the query string (invalid query syntax), or answered another 400 the server did not anticipate, whose upstream message is carried. `query_server_error`: Every attempt of a search with query set answered HTTP 500, as the portal does for some malformed queries in place of its 400 syntax rejection. `page_window_exceeded`: page × limit, the limit applied (at most 50), exceeds 10,000, the deepest match the portal pages to. `invalid_range`: year_from is after year_to, or min_events is above max_events. `rate_limited`: The portal's 60-a-minute budget is spent: it answered 429, or the request could not start within the call's deadline. data.retryAfter is set. `upstream_unreadable`: The portal answered with a body the server could not read: not JSON, missing the expected envelope, or over the byte ceiling (then data.retryable is false). Also raised when a search answers 404. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facets.description: Live counts under all other filters: each facet ignores its own filter. Terms list 10 values alphabetically (file_type: 100); type and category buckets list 10 secondary values. Overflow fields sum counts past these caps, counting a record once per value; other_count is 0 for year and number_events. cern_opendata_list_reference topics record_types/categories list all secondary values; a Primary::Secondary filter gives its record count as totalCount.

other_count.description: Summed count of the values past the bucket cap, not a record count.

totalCount.description: Total matches for the query and filters.

truncated.description: True when more results remain past this page; notice says how to reach them.
